issues: 480×270 设计坐标放大，词在 20–36px 档、粗细单一，画面像一团随机散落的标签云，没有"隧道"的结构
只有词本身在动，没有隧道壁或速度参照，纵深感全靠缩放，速度感很弱
近处词的运动模糊被封顶得很小，擦身而过时只是变大变糊，没有冲过镜头的拖尾
画面没有任何前景或视觉中心，卡片说它是背景层，demo 却没演示它怎么托住一个标题；词表是动效术语占位
changes: look 换成 midnight（深蓝黑 · 电光蓝），原生 1920 作画、透视手算 P=4400，隧道尽头一团电光蓝光晕按 2 次/片呼吸
加两层纵深参照：10 道扁椭圆发丝环作隧道壁同速推进，56 粒尘埃画成沿径向拉长的光速流线，整条隧道 ±2.5° 周期滚转
22 个产品能力关键词：sans 700 冷白三阶 + 6 个衬线斜体词 + 4 个带泛光的电光蓝强调词；远端大气雾、近端 6 层方向拖尾 + 失焦
正中压一组静态字标（HALYARD MOTION 眉题 + 112px「Every tool, one timeline.」+ 径向暗幕），飞进字标区的词自动压到 20%，演示背景层托标题的用法
循环改成 t = frame / 180，末帧的下一帧正好回到第 0 帧，2 整圈真正无缝
issuesEn: Scaled up from 480x270 design space, the words sat at 20-36px in one weight, so the frame read as a random tag cloud with no tunnel structure
Only the words moved, with no tunnel walls or speed reference, so depth relied on scale alone and the sense of speed was weak
Near-camera motion blur was capped low, so words just grew and blurred as they passed instead of streaking past the lens
There was no foreground or focal point: the card calls it a background layer but the demo never showed it carrying a title, and the word list was motion-jargon placeholder
changesEn: Midnight look (deep navy, electric blue), drawn natively at 1920 with hand-computed perspective P=4400, and an electric-blue glow at the tunnel's end breathing twice per loop
Two depth references were added: 10 flattened hairline rings advance as tunnel walls, 56 dust motes become radial light-speed streaks, and the whole tunnel rolls +/-2.5 degrees periodically

22 product-capability keywords: cool-white sans 700 in three tones, 6 serif italics and 4 glowing electric-blue accents, with atmospheric haze far away and a 6-layer directional trail plus defocus up close
A static lockup sits in the centre (HALYARD MOTION kicker, 112px 'Every tool, one timeline.', radial scrim), and words entering it drop to 20%, showing how the background layer carries a title
The loop now uses t = frame / 180, so the frame after the last is exactly frame 0, making two full cycles truly seamless
